FeatureProjects.Title: Selected work
FeatureProjects.Label: Case study

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: NeuralHire - CV / job matching
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: An end-to-end recruitment matching system that parses CVs, extracts skills and combines TF-IDF, embeddings and skill-based matching. It exposes explainable scores and recommendations through a FastAPI API and a Next.js interface.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: DXC user-management platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A connected web, mobile and API solution for managing DXC users by department, role and team. The platform includes a chatbot, care-report workflows and email notifications, with the web, mobile and server code maintained in dedicated repositories.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Recruitment process management
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A full-stack application that supports recruitment workflow design, application processing, sorting and follow-up. The Symfony codebase includes Doctrine ORM, Twig templates, forms and validation for the complete application flow.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: JobTest
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A production-oriented CV-job matching platform with document parsing, NLP extraction, semantic matching and candidate ranking. It brings together an Angular recruiter UI, Express API, FastAPI ML service, PostgreSQL and Docker deployment.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Personality AI
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: An NLP application that builds a synthetic Big Five dataset, trains and compares machine-learning models, and explains its predictions. The project serves inference through FastAPI and includes data preparation and model evaluation workflows.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Jebel Ressas eco experience
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A bilingual eco-tourism frontend for Jebel Ressas, Tunisia, with responsive storytelling, real landscape imagery and RTL support. It is built as a focused React and Vite experience with carefully paced scroll interactions.
